departures: The Docker daemon was not running in the container, so it was started with dockerd before any Docker step; machine.txt keeps the output from before and after.

The image build as written failed because containers do not trust the agent proxy's TLS certificate, so a local rust:1-bookworm was built from the pulled base plus only the proxy CA (update-ca-certificates), and the unchanged evals/sandbox/Dockerfile was built on top; both build logs are kept.
The image therefore contains the proxy CA certificate, which the earlier rounds' image did not.
evals/sandbox/projects was chowned to 1000:1000 on the host because sb creates project folders as root and the container runs as uid 1000; the failed runs before the chown are logged.
This session's own token usage is not available from inside the session, so usage is null; the only measured child cost is child_limits at 0.00137 USD, and the two claude_cli calls reported none.
child_limits used claude-haiku-5-5, as claude_cli did, since the issue sets no model for that probe.
